_comment: CI policy: failures that are ALLOWED today, with an owner and a reason.
Read by tools/gen_faces.mjs (key: gen_faces) and tools/ci.mjs (key: t_fit).
- a declared failure that occurs -> reported as KNOWN, does not break the build;
- a declared failure that STOPS occurring -> breaks the build as STALE, so a fix
forces the entry to be deleted and the allowlist can never rot;
That keeps the gate meaningful instead of permanently red. gen_faces --strict ignores
this file entirely and shows the true invariant state.
